== Summary ==
Before/after crops for [[Rebel Strike Team / Garrison Destroyed (PC Errata 2018 disc card)]]. Compared with [[Rebel Strike Team / Garrison Destroyed (PC Errata 2013 slip)]] (16 April 2013): the earlier slip and the same area of this card image, scaled to the slip's width; nothing else is edited.
